title: A text field selects by drag and copies with Ctrl+C
body:
The conversation has drag selection, word and line picking on a double or triple click, and copy on release, all in `src/select.rs`. A text field has none of it.

## Proposal

- A drag in a text field selects from the press to the pointer. A double click selects the word under the pointer, and a triple click selects its line. Word and line picking share their rules with `select::word_at` and `select::line_at`.
- Ctrl+C with a selection copies it and does nothing else. Without a selection, Ctrl+C keeps its meanings (cancel the turn, clear the prompt, arm the exit guard). Releasing the button does not copy.
- Typing replaces the selection. Backspace and Delete remove it. A cursor key drops it and moves from its matching end.
- The selection draws in the `selection` colour as the conversation's does. A text field has no mark button.
close_reason: ff3aa02 on dev adds the selection to `TextField`, with `select::word_char` shared with the conversation.
